title: Linux Administrator
description:
**Job Description (JD) – Data Center L2 Engineer (Linux Administrator).**

**Position:** Data Center L2 Engineer - Linux Administration  
**Experience:** 5+ Years  
**Location:** Hyderabad / Chennai Data Center  
**Department:** Infrastructure Operations / Data Center Operations  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Data Center L2 Engineer** with strong expertise in **Linux Administration** and exposure to **Python scripting** and **Ansible automation**. The candidate will be responsible for managing critical production environments, ensuring high availability, security compliance, infrastructure automation, performance optimization, and troubleshooting across enterprise Linux platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Linux Administration**

* Manage, administer, and support Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), CentOS, Rocky Linux, or Ubuntu servers.
* Perform OS installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, and lifecycle management.
* Monitor server health, system performance, CPU, memory, storage, and network utilization.
* Troubleshoot Linux OS, filesystem, kernel, service, and application-related issues.
* Manage user accounts, access controls, sudo permissions, and security policies.
* Handle LVM management, filesystem expansion, disk partitioning, and storage administration.
* Perform server hardening in accordance with organizational security standards.
* Configure and troubleshoot services such as SSH, NFS, FTP, DNS, NTP, and Apache/Nginx.

**Data Center Operations**

* Support production and DR infrastructure environments.
* Participate in planned maintenance, patching, upgrades, and change implementation activities.
* Coordinate with application, network, security, and storage teams for issue resolution.
* Ensure adherence to SLA, availability, and operational standards.

**Automation & Scripting**

* Develop and maintain automation scripts using Python for operational tasks.
* Create and manage Ansible playbooks for configuration management and server provisioning.
* Automate routine administration, patching, compliance checks, and reporting activities.
* Drive infrastructure-as-code and operational efficiency initiatives.

**Monitoring & Incident Management**

* Handle L2 incidents, root cause analysis (RCA), and problem management activities.
* Work with monitoring tools such as Nagios, Zabbix, Prometheus, Grafana, SolarWinds, or equivalent.
* Participate in on-call support and critical incident management.
* Prepare operational reports and documentation.

**Security & Compliance**

* Implement security patches and vulnerability remediation.
* Support audits, compliance reviews, and security assessments.
* Ensure adherence to cybersecurity standards and organizational policies.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Primary Skills**

* Linux Administration (RHEL/CentOS/UbuntuWindows)
* Server Performance Tuning
* Shell Scripting (Bash)
* Python Scripting
* Ansible Automation
* Patch & Vulnerability Management
* System Monitoring and Troubleshooting

**Secondary Skills**

* VMware/Virtualization
* SAN/NAS Storage Concepts
* Git Version Control
* Docker / Container Basics
* Basic Networking (TCP/IP, DNS, Routing, Firewall)
* ITIL Processes

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related discipline.
* 5+ years of experience in Linux System Administration in enterprise or data center environments.
* Hands-on experience with production support and mission-critical environments.
* Exposure to automation using Python and Ansible is mandatory.
* Experience working in BFSI, FinTech, Payment Systems, or 24x7 production environments will be preferred.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
